note: _timor Domini_ (Weber/Gryson, Clementina, NVg) _–_ fear of the Lord. Patristic sources have a second version: _pietas Domini_ – devotion toward the Lord. – Georges Folliet: La double tradition patristique du verset Job 28,28. “_pietas/timor_ Domini est sapientia.” _Sacris erudiri_ 45 (2006) 159– 189: the expression _timor Domini_ was introduced by Jerome (against the Septuagint and Augustine).
